entities.summary: Aleksandar Kitinov is a retired Macedonian professional tennis player. Kitinov turned pro in 1992 and retired in 2003. A doubles specialist, he won three titles during his career on the ATP Tour and reached a career-high ranking of No. 38 in November 1999.
